title: Demographic coverage report
description: Per-filter breakdown of how many inserted keys are attributed to each demographic bucket (Census 2010 race/ethnicity columns, plurality-labeled). Baseline for the Phase 4 G2 CI gate that watches parity-gap regressions across releases.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

filters.description: One record per Bloom filter built.

filter_name.description: Matches a name in the gazetteer manifest.

total_unique_keys.description: Number of unique keys after NFKC-lowercase dedup.

buckets.description: Exactly six buckets: five Census race/ethnicity groups plus 'unlabeled' for rows without a plurality label.

label.description: Census race/ethnicity bucket the keys were attributed to.

count.description: Number of unique keys in this bucket.

share.description: Share of total_unique_keys in this bucket; sums to 1.0 across all six buckets.

notes.description: Optional human note. Must comply with mechanism-description language rules.

parity_gap_points.description: Difference in percentage points between the highest-share and lowest-share labeled (non-unlabeled) bucket, across all filters. Phase 4 G2 CI gates this at <10 points; Phase 2 only reports the baseline.

generated_from_sources.description: Source corpora that contributed rows to the report.
